# volcano_anon_key (Resource)

A project anon key: a public JWT safe to embed in frontend code, with a per-key permission set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "volcano_anon_key" "frontend" {
  project_id  = volcano_project.example.id
  name        = "frontend-app"
  permissions = ["auth.signup", "auth.signin", "auth.refresh", "auth.logout"]
  is_default  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens only. Forces replacement if changed.
- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the project's default anon key. Only one key per project may be default; setting this to true demotes the previous default.
- `permissions` (List of String) Permissions granted to this key. Defaults to auth-only permissions when omitted. Forces replacement if changed.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `key_value` (String, Sensitive) The anon key JWT for use in an Authorization header.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import volcano_anon_key.frontend <project-id>,<key-id>
```
